name: elevated standing single leg calf raise
description: A one-leg calf raise on a step with a full stretch at the bottom. It builds calf strength and balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the ball of that foot on a step, other foot lifted.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Lower your heel below the step.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.
